context.title: Why the ontology is inconsistent
context.text:
Reasoner: HermiT.
The ontology is inconsistent: as it stands, nothing can satisfy all of it.
Justification 1 (the axioms that together force it):
  'has melting point in degrees Celsius' Range: xsd:float
  aluminium 'has melting point in degrees Celsius' "660.3"^^xsd:decimal
Note (OWL 2): xsd:decimal and xsd:float have disjoint value spaces: "660.3"^^xsd:decimal is not an xsd:float. The reasoner applies this.

message: Why is the ontology inconsistent? Explain the justification in plain language, and say which axiom is most likely the mistake.
